name: shonan-vibes
description: A quiet theme that follows the light of the Shonan coast through the day: moonlit night, violet dawn, blue-sky noon, golden sunset. One theme, one coastline, one day.

commands.title: Hold the Light at a Time of Day…

shonanVibes.dynamicColors.markdownDescription: Let the colors follow the sun. When off, **Shonan Vibes** is a static moonlit theme and nothing is written to your settings.

shonanVibes.intensity.markdownDescription: How much the light moves. `0` keeps the moonlit base all day, `0.5` is a subtle shift, `1` is the full Shonan day.

shonanVibes.updateInterval.markdownDescription: Minutes between checks of the light. Colors are only rewritten when the change would be perceptible, so long stretches of night or noon cause almost no updates.

shonanVibes.useLocalTime.markdownDescription: On: the coast is moved into your time zone, so sunrise and sunset happen at your local hours wherever you are. Off: the real-time sky over the configured coast (Shonan by default, Japan time).

shonanVibes.sunriseTime.markdownDescription: Override sunrise with a fixed time, `HH:MM`. Leave empty to compute the real sunrise for today.

shonanVibes.sunsetTime.markdownDescription: Override sunset with a fixed time, `HH:MM`. Leave empty to compute the real sunset for today.

shonanVibes.oceanSaturation.markdownDescription: Color strength of the sea, sky and accents. `0` is a gray-blue coast, `1` as designed, `1.5` a clearer summer sea. Syntax colors are not affected.

shonanVibes.nightDarkness.markdownDescription: How dark the night gets. `0` keeps nights a soft slate, `0.5` as designed, `1` nearly black.

shonanVibes.enableAtmosphericStatusBar.markdownDescription: Treat the status bar as the shoreline: sea color, a thin line of light on the horizon, and sand at the remote indicator. Off gives a plain dark status bar.

shonanVibes.statusBarIndicator.markdownDescription: Show a small dot in the status bar in the color of the current light (moon, dawn, sun, sunset). Hover it for the time of day; click to open the Shoreline.

shonanVibes.seasonalTint.markdownDescription: Small seasonal shifts: livelier summer sea, cooler winter blue, pastel spring dawns, warmer autumn evenings.

shonanVibes.fixedTime.markdownDescription: Hold the light at one time of day, `HH:MM`. Leave empty to follow the sun. Also set by **Shonan Vibes: Hold the Light at a Time of Day…**.

shonanVibes.latitude.markdownDescription: Latitude of the coast whose light you follow. Default: Enoshima, Shonan.

shonanVibes.longitude.markdownDescription: Longitude of the coast whose light you follow. Default: Enoshima, Shonan.

shonanVibes.cloudCover.markdownDescription: Manual cloud cover, `0` (clear) to `1` (overcast). Mutes the sky and sea; syntax colors are unchanged. Reserved for a future, optional weather source.

shonanVibes.shorelineMotion.markdownDescription: Let the water in the Shoreline view shimmer very slowly. It only runs while the view is visible and respects reduced-motion settings.
